emojis.title: At Least 19 Dead After Stampede at Indian Religious Event
emojis.summary: Such deadly crowd events are relatively common in India, and it was unclear what caused this one. The authorities detained the event’s organizer and others involved.

emojis.label: fire at canadian military base
emojis.title: Carney Says Fire at Canadian Forces Base Wainwright in Alberta Killed 4 and Injured Dozens
emojis.summary: Prime Minister Mark Carney said the “violent, fast-moving” fire on Saturday in Alberta was one of the worst tragedies for Canada’s armed forces in peacetime on Canadian soil.

emojis.title: Funding shortages force World Food Programme to cut aid to Gaza
emojis.summary: The number of people helped by the UN agency in the Palestinian territory will drop by about a third - from 1.6 million to 1.1 million.

emojis.summary: Three celebrities date artificial intelligence avatars on a reality show made in South Korea, where A.I. is hugely popular.

emojis.title: France in Shock After Protests Turn Into Riots, Damaging Buildings and Shops
emojis.summary: After anti-government protests devolved into chaos, leaders from across the political spectrum blamed one another for the unrest, even as it largely subsided on Sunday.
